title: A two-hit mechanism triggers autoimmune hair loss
title_zh: 两击机制诱发自身免疫性脱发
abstract: Autoimmune diseases arise from a breakdown of immune tolerance, yet the mechanisms that initiate tissue-specific autoimmunity remain poorly understood1–4. Here we identify a two-hit mechanism in which immune dysregulation and physiological neural activation converge to trigger autoimmune alopecia. We show that transient depletion of regulatory T (Treg) cells during the anagen phase of the hair cycle, but not during telogen, induces CD8+ T-cell-mediated destruction of immune-privileged hair follicle stem cells (HFSCs), resulting in hair loss. This anagen-restricted susceptibility depends on sympathetic nerve activity, which is physiologically elevated during anagen: sympathetic denervation prevents disease, whereas psychological stress or optogenetic activation of sympathetic nerves renders otherwise resistant telogen skin susceptible to autoimmune attack after Treg cell depletion. Mechanistically, sympathetic noradrenaline signalling through HFSC-intrinsic ADRB2 promotes physiological reactivation of endogenous retroviruses (ERVs) in anagen HFSCs. Under conditions of Treg cell depletion, this ERV-associated state drives autoimmune pathology by engaging AIM2-dependent innate immune activation and pathogenic CD8+ T cell responses. Accordingly, genetic ablation of Aim2 or pharmacological inhibition of ERV reverse transcription protects against disease development. Together, these findings show that physiological sympathetic activity establishes a transiently vulnerable epithelial state, whereas Treg cells prevent this state from progressing to tissue-specific autoimmunity. This neuro–epithelial–immune circuit links hair-cycle state to the breach of HFSC immune privilege and the initiation of autoimmune alopecia. Immune dysregulation and physiological neural activation converge to trigger autoimmune alopecia.
abstract_zh: 自身免疫性疾病源于免疫耐受的崩溃，但启动组织特异性自身免疫的机制仍知之甚少1–4。本研究确定了一种两击机制，其中免疫失调和生理神经激活汇聚以诱发自身免疫性斑秃。我们显示，在毛发生长期（anagen期）而非休止期（telogen期）暂时性耗竭调节性T细胞（Treg细胞），会诱导CD8+ T细胞介导的免疫特权毛囊干细胞（HFSCs）破坏，从而导致脱发。这种anagen期特异性易感性依赖于交感神经活动，该活动在毛发生长期生理上升高：交感神经去耗竭可防止疾病，而心理压力或交感神经光遗传激活则使本应具有抵抗力的休止期皮肤在Treg细胞耗竭后易于自身免疫攻击。机制上，通过HFSCs内源性受体β2（ADRB2）的交感神经适定素信号传导，促进了anagen HFSCs中内源性逆转录病毒（ERVs）的生理激活。在Treg细胞耗竭的条件下，这种ERV相关状态通过AIM2依赖的固有免疫激活和病理性CD8+ T细胞反应驱动自身免疫病理。因此，Aim2的基因敲除或ERV逆转录酶的药物抑制可保护免疫免疫病理的发生。总之，这些发现表明，生理交感神经活动建立了一个暂时易感的上皮状态，而Treg细胞则防止该状态进展为组织特异性自身免疫。这种神经–上皮–免疫电路将毛发生长状态与HFSCs免疫特权的丧失以及自身免疫性斑秃的发病联系在一起。免疫失调和生理神经激活汇聚以诱发自身免疫性脱发。
